modifications: trades[0].price changed from the string "1260.01" to the JSON NUMBER 1260.01. The AsyncAPI types price as a string, so this is not a documented form. It is tested because ADR-001 §8.2 records that another venue in this repository does send JSON-number decimals, and because a price that arrives as an IEEE-754 double has already lost exactness before any adapter sees it.

expectation: Classified REJECTED/SHAPE, with a typed anomaly naming the field and carrying the raw frame. The value is NOT accepted and converted: a JSON number is not an exact decimal, and silently reading one would put an inexact economic value into the system (§7.3, ADR-001 §7). If Coinbase is ever documented to send numbers here, the fix is an explicit, cited normalization in normalize.ts — not a relaxation of this schema.
